<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion appears at m/z 211.0764. This is most consistent with a [M+H]⁺ ion, giving a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈210.069 Da. Searching for formulas that match this mass and the observed isotopic pattern (≈10–12 % M+1 intensity, indicating ~10–11 carbons) points to C₁₀H₁₂NO₄ (exact mass 210.0766 Da), which is the closest match within typical HR‑MS error. Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C10H12O4N, formatted as required.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H12O4N</final_answer>
